# Google Play release notes for the next build (at most 500 characters).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

• Chat: react with any emoji, reply, copy, delete for you, and send photos (location removed).
• Disappearing messages, Clear chat and Keep messages in the chat menu.
• Contacts' photos in Messages and chat.
• Wallet passes stack like cards: tap to bring one forward, swipe down to put it back.
• Smoother screens, and privacy and security improvements.
